mapper.update: DO $$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_type WHERE typname = 'prescription_adjustment_status_enum') THEN CREATE TYPE prescription_adjustment_status_enum AS ENUM ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'DECLINED', 'EXPIRED'); END IF; END $$; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS prescription_adjustments ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, plan_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES plans(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, source_workout_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES workouts(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, source_exercise_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, first_feedback_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES exercise_feedbacks(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, second_feedback_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES exercise_feedbacks(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, target_workout_id UUID REFERENCES workouts(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, target_prescription_id UUID REFERENCES prescriptions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, original_prescription JSONB, suggested_prescription JSONB, suggested_exercise_id VARCHAR(64) REFERENCES exercises(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, reason TEXT NOT NULL, reason_en TEXT NOT NULL, status prescription_adjustment_status_enum NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, processed_at TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT chk_adjustment_target_for_pending CHECK (status <> 'PENDING' OR target_prescription_id IS NOT NULL), CONSTRAINT chk_adjustment_feedback_pair CHECK (first_feedback_id <> second_feedback_id) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_adjustment_second_feedback ON prescription_adjustments(second_feedback_id); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_pending_adjustment_target ON prescription_adjustments(target_prescription_id) WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND target_prescription_id IS NOT NULL; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_adjustments_plan_status ON prescription_adjustments(plan_id, status, created_at DESC);
